summary.text: Gregory Anderson is the Democratic candidate for the Maryland House of Delegates, District 35A, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the June 23, 2026 Democratic primary.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a computer scientist and electrical engineer who helps new technology startups and serves as a Harford County election judge.

paragraphs.text: Anderson said in a Ballotpedia survey that he was born and raised in Harford County, the son of federal workers and grandson of farmers.
He said he built and sold a software company, led teams at Hewlett-Packard, and recruited and conducted full opera productions.
Anderson said District 35A is represented by Republicans who cannot chair committees or move bills, and that he would work with Democrats to deliver results for Harford and Cecil Counties.
He listed education, land use, technology and the Chesapeake Bay as his policy interests.
